properties.description:
When a session captures intent by READING a document — a feedback file, a brief, a handover note, a spec someone emailed — the skill registers that document as an Artifact and draws DOCUMENTS from it to every node the reading produced. The link is made at capture time, by the skill that is already holding the file open, rather than by anybody remembering to come back for it.

WHY IT IS NEEDED, measured on reflow2's own design 2026-08-11 rather than assumed. `req:no-idea-goes-quiet` is ACCEPTED and requires the backward half explicitly — "BACKWARD to the document and location it was written in. The user must never again have to recall that they wrote something, hunt for the file, and hand-point an agent at it." Its statement also says the backward half is handled: "already carried by ingest: every extracted node gets YIELDED to its provenance Fragment."

  Requirements in the design                                        154
  with ANY backward provenance edge (YIELDED or DOCUMENTS)            1
  without                                                           153

⇒ THE CLAIM IS TRUE OF A PATH THIS DESIGN BARELY USES. 148 Fragments exist, and they hang off Artifacts, not Requirements. Requirements here arrive by CONVERSATION — an agent reads something or listens to somebody and calls `add_requirement` — and that path records no source at all. The covered path and the used path are different paths, which is why an accepted requirement can be 1/154 satisfied without anybody noticing.

⭐ THE PROOF IS THE SESSION THAT FOUND IT. On 2026-08-11 Anthony had to tell an agent that reflow2's governance work came from `dev_storyflow/reflow2_feedback.md`, because nothing in the graph said so. `req:no-idea-goes-quiet` was captured on 2026-08-04 FROM HIS COMPLAINT ABOUT DOING EXACTLY THAT — "It was always manual process of me trying to find the document or documents that I had written the idea/requirement in and then purposefully point the agent to it." Seven days after recording the complaint, the design made him do the thing he complained about.

SCOPE, deliberately narrow. This covers capture FROM A DOCUMENT, where a file exists to point at. It does NOT attempt the harder case — intent that arrives in conversation with no document behind it, where the honest source is a session rather than a path — because inventing an Artifact for a conversation would put a fabricated file location in the graph, and `req:a-repair-suggestion-never-proposes-fabrication` is accepted. That case is left open rather than half-answered.

WHAT IT MUST NOT DO, taken from the parent requirement's own warning: it must not auto-draw SATISFIES or REALIZES from similarity. DOCUMENTS is a provenance edge — "this text is where that came from" — and carries no claim that anything was delivered. The parent is explicit that auto-linking delivery "would make every captured idea read as delivered and the completion reading say 100% forever."

ORIGIN: promoted from `dec:idea-should-a-requirement-trace-back-to-its-demand-signal`, option (b), on Anthony's word 2026-08-11. Option (a) — a detector for a Requirement with no origin edge — was NOT taken, because at genesis nobody has a source document and such a check would fire against an entire design on day one, with fabrication as the only way to green it.
properties.name: Capture FROM a document registers that document and links what came out of it, so the backward half of the thread exists by construction
